title: Make Get Started button functional with App Coming Soon interaction

requirements.summary: Make the "Get Started" button fully clickable and functional with "App Coming Soon" interaction
acceptanceCriteria: Clicking the "Get Started" button triggers a visible "App Coming Soon" message or navigates to a placeholder page
The button is not blocked by any other UI elements (z-index and pointer-events are correct)
The interaction works consistently on desktop and mobile devices

file_operations.description: Add click handler to the "Get Started" button in the hero section that displays a toast notification with "App Coming Soon" message; ensure the button has proper z-index (z-10 or higher) and pointer-events-auto to prevent blocking; verify no overlay elements interfere with button clicks
Create shadcn/ui toast component for displaying the "App Coming Soon" message; this component provides accessible, mobile-friendly notifications
Create shadcn/ui toaster component that manages toast notifications and renders them in a fixed position on screen
Create shadcn/ui toast hook that provides the toast() function for triggering notifications programmatically
Add the Toaster component to the root App component so toast notifications can be displayed globally throughout the application

requirements.summary: Apply premium gold styling to the "Get Started" button
acceptanceCriteria: Button has medium border radius and soft shadow
Styling matches the premium dark theme of the landing page

file_operations.description: Update the "Get Started" button styling to use background color #D4AF37 (gold), white text color, medium border radius (rounded-md or rounded-lg), and a soft shadow (shadow-md or shadow-lg); ensure the button maintains visual hierarchy and premium aesthetic consistent with the existing dark luxury theme

requirements.summary: Add smooth hover and click animations to the "Get Started" button
acceptanceCriteria: Button scales up slightly on hover (smooth transition)
Button shows a small press animation on click
Animations work correctly on both desktop and mobile devices
Animations are subtle and do not negatively impact usability

file_operations.description: Add smooth interaction animations to the "Get Started" button: on hover, apply scale-105 transform with transition-transform duration-200; on active/click state, apply scale-95 for a brief press-down effect; ensure transitions are smooth and mobile-friendly using Tailwind's hover: and active: modifiers
